description.zh: 开始时间，默认查询当天的时间。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. By default, the system queries data of the current day.

description.zh: 结束时间，不能超过24小时。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The time range cannot exceed 24 hours.

description.zh:
排序名称。取值：
- FirstFrameDuration：首帧耗时
- PlayDuration：播放时长
- VideoDuration：视频时长
- StuckDuration：卡顿时长
description.en:
The criteria by which the sorting is performed. Valid values:

- FirstFrameDuration

- PlayDuration

- VideoDuration

- StuckDuration

description.zh:
排序类型。取值：
- DESC：倒序 
- ASC：正序
description.en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- DESC: descending order.

- ASC: ascending order.
The number of entries per page.

description.zh:
播放类型。取值：
- vod：点播
description.en:
The playback type. Valid value:

- vod

description.zh:
播放状态。取值：
- complete：播放完成
- playing：播放中
- unusual：播放异常
description.en:
The playback status. Valid values:

- complete

- playing

- unusual: A playback error occurs.
